mechanism_narrative: The two-week reversal in WORKPLACES from -53.1 to -28.0 percent below baseline shows commuting routines re-forming after the holiday trough; returning workplace footfall restores weekday trips that spill over into neighbouring retail catchments, lifting RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES rose from -53.1 at t-2w to -28.0 at t-0w
failure_condition: Across the next 28 days RETAIL_REC does not exceed its trailing 28-day mean following two consecutive weeks of rising WORKPLACES.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL has fallen from 11.3 to 8.4 percent above baseline, meaning the stay-at-home surplus is unwinding; each point of time shifted out of the home reallocates household hours to out-of-home activity and raises RETAIL_REC within two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL fell from 11.3 at t-1w to 8.4 at t-0w
failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL declines further over four weeks while RETAIL_REC stays flat or falls, showing no reallocation of home time into discretionary trips.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT crossing back above -56 percent, from -58.3 to -55.1, marks the trough of trip suppression; transit-linked discretionary journeys resume and retail-and-recreation footfall rises over the following two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT improves by more than 2 points week-on-week from a level below -55 percent
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT moved from -58.3 at t-1w to -55.1 at t-0w, a 3.2 point improvement
failure_condition: TRANSIT holds above -55 for two consecutive weeks while the following fortnight's RETAIL_REC mean falls below the prior fortnight's.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM turning negative and deepening, from -2.0 to -6.0, signals the unwind of household stockpiling; the released household basket is redirected to discretionary categories, lifting RETAIL_REC over two weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM falls below -4 percent from a positive four-week-ago level
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM fell from 3.6 at t-3w to -6.0 at t-0w
failure_condition: GROCERY_PHARM remains below zero for four weeks while RETAIL_REC shows no gain over its trailing 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: Retail recovery requires the joint movement of WORKPLACES rising and RESIDENTIAL falling in the same week; when both co-move, home time is converted into commuting and shopping trips and RETAIL_REC rises over four weeks, while divergent weeks offset each other.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES rises week-on-week in the same week RESIDENTIAL falls week-on-week
evidence_refs: fact:at t-0w WORKPLACES at -28.0 coincided with RESIDENTIAL at 8.4, down from 11.3
failure_condition: Weeks in which WORKPLACES rises and RESIDENTIAL falls are followed by RETAIL_REC declines at least as often as increases over the next 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: Mid-January is Melbourne's summer holiday peak, and the positive PARKS excursion of +11.4 at t-2w reflects outdoor leisure demand that bundles with discretionary shopping trips within one week, so RETAIL_REC rises week-on-week in holiday weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS prints above 0 percent above baseline in a given week
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS reached +11.4 at t-2w after -17.1 at t-3w
regime_hint: summer holiday season with low case counts
failure_condition: In weeks where PARKS is above baseline, the following week's RETAIL_REC is not higher than the same week's RETAIL_REC.

mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC has deteriorated monotonically from -14.4 to -22.6 over three weeks; this level shift reflects a tourism and CBD-worker deficit that does not self-correct inside a month, so the next 28-day mean stays below the trailing 28-day mean.
candidate_trigger: RETAIL_REC falls more than 5 points versus its level four weeks earlier
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC declined from -14.4 at t-3w to -22.6 at t-0w while TRANSIT stayed below -50
failure_condition: After a fall of more than 5 points over three weeks, RETAIL_REC's next-28-day mean exceeds its trailing 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT held near -55 and WORKPLACES near -28 reflect continuing density caps and remote-work directives; commuter- and office-dependent retail catchments stay suppressed, so RETAIL_REC remains below its trailing mean over four weeks until those caps are lifted.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT remains below -40 percent for three consecutive weekly means
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT at -55.1 and WORKPLACES at -28.0 in the final weekly mean
regime_hint: restrictions in force with density caps
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises above its trailing 28-day mean while TRANSIT stays below -40 for all four weeks of the horizon.
